capabilities.summary: Discover installed skills first and optionally search public skill sources with a sanitized query.
useWhen: The user asks to find or compare skills for a task.
The user wants to know whether a specialized workflow is already available.
doNotUseWhen: The request is to install, update, or remove a skill rather than discover one.
External search would require disclosing private prompt text, secrets, local paths, or internal identifiers.

output.description: Conceptual sections for the host model's human-readable search report. No package Adapter guarantees a strict JSON envelope or exact field presence.

sideEffects: May send sanitized generic keywords to a public skill search service when network search is allowed.

capabilities.summary: Install one selected skill into the current project after explicit approval of the exact target.
useWhen: The user explicitly approves the displayed project-scope command, source, skill, and target agent.
doNotUseWhen: The user only asked to search, find, compare, or recommend skills.
Approval is ambiguous, applies to user scope, or does not identify the selected skill and target.

output.description: Conceptual installation-result sections. The approved npx command and host determine the real stdout; this Skill does not provide a JSON Adapter.

sideEffects: Writes skill files or links and skill metadata inside the current project.
May download content from the approved source.

when: Before executing the exact project-scope installation command.

capabilities.summary: Install one selected skill into user-level agent configuration after explicit approval of the exact target.
useWhen: The user explicitly approves the displayed user-scope command, source, skill, and target agent.
doNotUseWhen: The user only asked to search, find, compare, or recommend skills.
Approval is ambiguous, applies to project scope, or does not identify the selected skill and target.

output.description: Conceptual installation-result sections. The approved npx command and host determine the real stdout; this Skill does not provide a JSON Adapter.

sideEffects: Writes skill files or links and skill metadata outside the project into user-level agent configuration.
May download content from the approved source.

when: Before executing the exact user-scope installation command.
